title: Methods for interpreting and understanding deep neural networks
research_question: How can we interpret and understand deep neural network models and their predictions?
core_contribution: This tutorial provides an overview of techniques for interpreting deep neural networks, focusing on activation maximization for interpreting concepts and layer-wise relevance propagation for explaining individual decisions, with practical recommendations.
conclusion: Building transparent machine learning systems is important for extracting domain knowledge and model validation, and this tutorial covered interpreting concepts learned by models and explaining individual decisions.
key_findings: Activation maximization can produce more realistic prototypes when using a data density expert or a generative model.
Sensitivity analysis explains the variation of the function, while decomposition techniques explain the function value itself.
Layer-wise relevance propagation can be understood as a deep Taylor decomposition for ReLU networks.
Practical recommendations for applying LRP include using deep Taylor LRP rules and choosing appropriate model architectures.
